purpose: Provider rows models.dev does not carry: models published only at lab level, and providers models.dev does not list. Current reads serve these rows from this file; every start also records each row's claim in the store, so a point-in-time read serves the claim in force at its instant. Login methods are an allowlist, not a preference.

models.source_ref: Read 2026-11-15. https://exa.ai/pricing: "Each endpoint has a base price per request that includes up to 10 results." The `/search` (`auto`, `fast`) row states "$7 / 1k requests" as its base price and "$1 / 1k results" for each result above 10. Results above 10 incur that additional charge, which is not served as a rate. https://docs.exa.ai/reference/search, `type`: "The search mode to use. Defaults to `auto`, a balanced mode recommended for most applications." Text and highlights inside `/search` have no separate published charge. https://exa.ai/docs/search/quickstart sets `type="auto"` and `contents={"highlights": True}`; its example response itemises `"costDollars": { "total": 0.007, "search": { "neural": 0.007 } }`, the base $0.007. AI page summaries are separately priced, not included in this rate. No increment or minimum is stated, so both are unknown.

Read 2026-11-15. https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/search: "Search and Fetch are billed per successful request, not by tokens or by the number of returned results:" Billing table: "Search | Per 1,000 successful requests | $0.75". "Failed requests, empty search results, and timeouts are not billed." "`count` only controls how many results are returned and does not affect the per-request price." The served rate is $0.75 per 1,000 successful Search requests. No increment or minimum is stated, so both are unknown.

Read 2026-11-15. https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/kimi-code/membership.html: "Kimi Code 是 Kimi 会员权益 中面向开发者的智能编程服务，随 Kimi 会员订阅一同提供，与 Kimi 会员共享同一套额度。CLI、VS Code、桌面端及第三方工具发起的请求，均计入该额度。" "所有登录设备和 API Key 共享同一套配额；超过 30 天未活跃的设备会自动解绑，重新 `/login` 即可恢复。" Kimi Code membership requests share the membership quota. No per-search price is published for this endpoint, so no rate is served. The provider id matches the API-key identity `apikey:kimi-for-coding`.

Read 2026-11-15. https://ollama.com/blog/web-search: "Web search is included with a free Ollama account, with much higher rate limits available by upgrading your Ollama subscription." "Create an API key from your Ollama account." No per-search price is published, so no rate is served; included access is not a zero-dollar rate.

Read 2026-11-15. https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-credits: "Basic Search (`basic`):" "Each request costs 1 API credit." "Pay-as-you-go: $0.008 per credit (allows you to be charged per credit once your plan’s credit limit is reached)." Monthly plans include credits; this is the pay-as-you-go price per credit, yielding $8 per 1,000 basic-depth searches, not a monthly-plan effective price or the advanced-depth price. No increment or minimum is stated, so both are unknown.

Read 2026-11-15. https://brave.com/search/api, Search plan: "$5 per 1,000 requests". https://brave.com/search/api/guides/what-sets-brave-search-api-apart: "Brave Search API paid plans begin at $3 CPM." The rate depends on the plan; the served rate is the Search plan displayed on the pricing page, not the guide's starting price. No increment or minimum is stated, so both are unknown.

OpenAI's Decisions API: POST /v1/decisions with model gpt-6-luna. This row is that endpoint, not the gpt-6-luna chat row. Read 2026-11-04 at https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions: "Send requests to `POST /v1/decisions` using `gpt-6-luna`, the only currently supported model."; "The Decisions API evaluates text, images, and JSON and returns typed answers"; "Files, audio, and item references aren't supported."; "Provide images as inline base64 data URLs or publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs."; "With `gpt-6-luna`, uncached input costs **$0.10 per 1M tokens**. Prompt cache hits receive discounted input pricing; cache writes are charged. Cache-read and cache-write rates match the standard `gpt-6-luna` prompt caching rates. Output tokens are not charged."; "Regional processing premiums and long-context input pricing multipliers apply." https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, standard table, row gpt-6-luna: short context cached input $0.01, short context 30m write $0.125, 12h write $0.25. Served: the short-context rates and the 30-minute cache write. Not served: the 12-hour cache write, long-context rates above 272K input tokens, and regional premiums, so a long-context or regional request costs more than these rates. The page states no context window or image size limits.
